config.section.General.name: General
config.ColorMatch.name: Match UI Mod
config.ColorMatch.description: Change the colors of the bold and sprite fonts to match your UI recolor or retexture. 'Auto' will try to figure it out, or you can choose whichever one you like.
config.section.Bold Font.name: Bold Font
config.section.Bold Font.description: The font used for dialogue boxes, NPC speech, mail, and some menus (like this one!) for section headings.
config.BoldEnabled.name: Enable
config.BoldNumerals.name: Numeral style
config.BoldNumerals.description: Text numerals vary in height and look more like lowercase letters. Lining numerals are all the same height, like uppercase.
config.BoldSS01.name: Letter style (a, g)
config.BoldSS01.description: Choose between two-storey 'a' and binocular 'g' (default), or simpler, handwriting-style forms for those letters (plain).
config.section.Sprite Fonts.name: Sprite Fonts
config.section.Sprite Fonts.description: The fonts used for most interface elements: inventory, tooltips (like this one!), etc.
config.SpriteEnabled.name: Enable
config.SpriteNumerals.name: Numeral style
config.SpriteNumerals.description: Text numerals vary in height and look more like lowercase letters. Lining numerals are all the same height, like uppercase.
config.SpriteSS01.name: Letter style (a, g)
config.SpriteSS01.description: Choose between two-storey 'a' and binocular 'g' (default), or simpler, handwriting-style forms for those letters (plain).
